ios.desc:
Rolly - Your Personal AI Finance Advisor, Money Manager, and Budget Planner

Tired of switching between budgeting apps, logging entries by hand, and still not knowing where your money goes?

Meet Rolly, the all-in-one AI finance tracker and monthly budget planner designed to simplify how you manage money, track spending, and save smarter -- all through an intuitive AI chat.

Whether you are a working professional or managing multiple income streams, Rolly makes money management effortless and fun. Just snap receipts, use your voice, or log expenses through chat. Rolly is the only budgeting app you will ever need.

WHY CHOOSE ROLLY?

Managing money should not feel like a chore. While most budgeting apps just track numbers, Rolly does more -- it talks to you and adapts to your style. Feeling spendy? Let Rolly's Angry Mom personality call you out. Need a push to save? Switch to Wise Friend for practical advice.

TRACK EXPENSES YOUR WAY

- Chat to Track: Type "Coffee 15, Movie 5" and Rolly instantly logs them under the right categories. No dropdowns, no forms.
- Speak to Log: Use voice input to record expenses hands-free.
- Scan Receipts: Snap and upload receipts. Rolly auto-logs each item as a separate transaction in the correct category.
- AI Categorization: Every transaction is instantly sorted with pinpoint accuracy.

POWERFUL MONEY MANAGEMENT

- Smart Budgets: Create monthly budgets with AI-generated suggestions based on your spending patterns.
- Savings Goals: Set targets, visualize progress, and reach financial milestones faster.
- Debt Tracking: Monitor and manage all your debts with clear payoff timelines.
- Multiple Wallets: Separate work, travel, family, and personal spending.
- Shared Wallets: Collaborate with friends or family on group budgets and recurring transactions.
- Bank Connections: Link your bank accounts for automatic transaction imports.

STAY MOTIVATED

- Financial Challenges: Challenge friends to saving or spending goals. Make budgeting social and fun.
- AI Personalities: Switch between sassy, wise, or strict -- Rolly adapts to your vibe and keeps you accountable.
- Analytics Dashboard: Beautiful charts, spending insights, milestones, and calendar views.

BUILT FOR EVERYONE

- Multi-Currency Support: Track finances in any currency, perfect for travelers and expats.

quotes.text:
Hello everyone,

I have created Rolly: AI Money Tracker - a new AI expense tracker where you can easily record your transactions just by chatting with our bot Rolly and it will automatically record and categorise the transaction into the most suitable category (you can also create any of your own category and it will also take care of it in consideration). You can always talk to the AI in any language and your transaction in any currency and it will always convert it into the base currency you've selected earlier. Rolly will also respond to your transaction in a interesting manner to make your expense tracker journey more interesting!

App Store: https://apps.apple.com/au/app/rolly-ai-money-tracker/id6636525257

Play Store: https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.jc.rollymoneytracker

Anyone that have any feedback or needs for any new feature, do feel free to let me know and I'm happy to discuss and incorporate it. Thanks.

quotes.text:
Hello everyone, I was always thinking about how I can increase my finances to get out of the rat race. Apart from increasing my income, the other approach I did is to reduce my expenses and hence I started my journey on expense tracking.

I have tried a few apps and most of the time these apps are too complicated and I didn't manage to consistently key in my expense. Though there are some apps that provide link to bank account spending but I think that defeats the purpose of expense tracker since I believe only by manually input your spending in, only you'll be aware of your spending.

This drives me to have a thought about how can I improve this and I decided to create my own app to make this work. I created Rolly: AI Money Tracker - a new AI expense tracker where you can easily record your transactions just by chatting with our bot Rolly and it will automatically record and categorise the transaction into the most suitable category (you can also create any of your own category and it will also take care of it in consideration). Demo video here. More features like budgeting are on the way, stay tuned!

App Store: https://apps.apple.com/au/app/rolly-ai-money-tracker/id6636525257

Play Store: https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.jc.rollymoneytracker

Anyone that have any feedback or needs for any new feature, do feel free to let me know and I'm happy to discuss and incorporate it. Thanks.
